package.description: Open-source AI API gateway for the command line, with a browser management console.

en-US.description: Open-source AI API gateway for the command line, with a browser management console.
en-US.longDescription:
GPROXY CLI runs an AI API gateway from a terminal. Start it with gproxy serve and open http://127.0.0.1:8787/console/ to manage the instance in your browser.

Connect your own providers and manage credentials, model routing, load balancing, failover, access keys, quotas and usage. Supported routes provide OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible API formats. Provider accounts, model access and service charges are separate from this application.
en-US.name: GPROXY CLI
